request: Make a promo film for LitCodex, the lit workflow plugin for Codex CLI, to sit in its GitHub README, set in Pretendard with fewer words, larger type and more whitespace. Korean copy variant.
pathReason: The film draws four check rings, a handoff sheet and a terminal pane, which are shapes and a diagram beyond type.
idea: A single ember becomes a goal with four checks, and a handoff carries the one that stayed open into the next session, where it finally goes green.
audience: Developers who work in Codex CLI and lose the thread between sessions.
channel: GitHub README section and link previews
formatReason: The README column and video players are landscape.

beats.purpose: Hook: the one word a person types
beats.onScreen: A very large cream word lit fills the left of the frame with an unlit ember dot after it; the ember ignites orange, and a slim terminal pane types a lit request
beats.motion: The word settles from a slight push-in; the ember ignites and glows; the sub-line rises through a mask; the pane slides up and types
beats.sound: Pad and pulse from the first quarter second; a rise toward the end of the beat

beats.purpose: The request becomes a goal with checks
beats.onScreen: The headline 목표 하나, 확인 넷. rises in; the ember travels along an arc and becomes the first of four empty check rings in a row
beats.motion: Letters exit upward through their mask; the ember flies to the row and its fill drains into an outline; three more rings draw on in sequence
beats.sound: Hit on the cut into the goal

beats.purpose: Checks earn green only with evidence; one stays open
beats.onScreen: 초록은 증거가 있어야. Three rings fill lime with a drawn check and an evidence tag; the fourth ring holds an orange outline tagged not verified yet, with a line saying the fourth stays open
beats.motion: Fills grow from the ring centre in turn, checks draw on, the open ring breathes orange
beats.sound: Hit on the cut into the checks; a rise into the open check

beats.purpose: Handoff carries the unfinished work forward
beats.onScreen: handoff만 보내세요. The pane types handoff and a cream sheet with Decisions, Remaining work and Where to resume rises out of it; an orange line links the open ring to Remaining work while the green rings dim
beats.motion: The sheet rises with a slight tilt and levels; its rules draw on; the connector draws from the ring to the sheet
beats.sound: Hit on the cut into the handoff

beats.purpose: A new session resumes and closes the open check
beats.onScreen: 다음 세션, 같은 자리. A fresh pane types a request to read the handoff; the sheet is read heading by heading with orange underlines; the open ring turns lime with a drawn check
beats.motion: The pane clears and retypes; underlines draw in order; the connector turns lime; the fourth ring fills and draws its check; the sheet drops away
beats.sound: Hit on the cut into the new session

beats.purpose: Resolve: the closed check becomes the emblem
beats.onScreen: The other rings fade; the fourth ring scales up into a large lime ring holding the five-row LIT mark; LitCodex and Keep the work lit. settle at left; the pane runs litcodex doctor and prints All checks passed.
beats.motion: Match cut by scale: the small ring grows and travels into the emblem; wordmark rises through a mask; the doctor line types
beats.sound: Cadence: a struck tonic chord to close the film

subject.name: A signup-form task carried across two sessions
specifics: Four check rings that turn lime only when evidence is recorded, with one that stays open across the handoff
A cream handoff sheet with Decisions, Remaining work and Where to resume, linked by a line to the check that is still open

typePlan.hierarchy: One large Pretendard Bold line per beat with a single accent word; small Pretendard Regular support lines; MesloLGS NF only inside the drawn terminal pane and its tags

palette.role: ink background, taken from the cover's near-black
cream type and paper, from the LIT mark
orange accent, the cover's rim light and the mark's stem
lime for passed checks only, from the mark

sound.plan: A slow minor pad with a felt pulse; hits on the cuts, a rise into the open check and a struck chord to close

inventions: A signup-form task carried across two sessions (the subject's name)
Four check rings that turn lime only when evidence is recorded, with one that stays open across the handoff (specific)
A cream handoff sheet with Decisions, Remaining work and Where to resume, linked by a line to the check that is still open (specific)
All Korean copy lines other than the product name and tagline
ambition: A restrained, cinematic README film: one idea per beat, very large type with generous whitespace, one continuous ember-to-ring gesture that carries the story, and a scale match cut into the closing emblem.
